confirmedIssues.mechanism: Local readiness uses isLoading, activeId and result.ok, not resolved/paused source state. TanStack initial paused queries can be pending with isLoading=false. A paused or disabled unresolved list enters noDrives; paused detail enters noEnergy; initial list loading does not make the summary/takeaway loading because detail is still disabled. A fatal detail gets an accurate QueryError in Energy but still the noEnergy text in Takeaway. retained includes refreshError only, so retained paused sources can be labeled Source available by the brief.
confirmedIssues.repro: SOURCE REPRO ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: set drives data undefined/isPending=true/fetchStatus=paused/isLoading=false/error=null. activeId is empty, so line182 emits No drives found before any successful list response. With a resolved list and detail data undefined/paused, line271 and line330 emit lacks energy although no drive evidence has resolved. With cached valid detail and fetchStatus=paused, retained=false and result.ok=true yield Source available while DataSourceNotice separately reports paused.

Pass an honest sourceStatus to the existing brief rather than expanding shared trust APIs.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: When telemetry supplies no finite ambient reading, nativeAmbient falls back to the scenario ambient knob. Moving that knob changes climate0 and possibly other/total and baselineArrivalSoc, so the Actual drive baseline is not fixed for a fixed recording. For modeled0>observed, baseline total itself moves; otherwise the component split still changes.
confirmedIssues.repro: SOURCE REPRO ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: hold a valid drive and empty or field-null telemetry fixed, vary only knobs.ambientC from 18 to -10. analyzeTelemetry returns ambientC=null/climateOn=true; nativeAmbient follows the knob, changing baseline climate power at lines114-117/151. Nothing in the drive record changed.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: The sole ok=false result carries no ineligibility reason and merges missing drive, distance<10, observed<=0 and speed<=0. Page always describes this as missing energy. A measured zero energy, positive energy on a short recording, or known zero average speed are different facts from an absent energy measurement. Neutral zero fields are correctly suppressed by the summary, but source/domain reasons are not preserved.
confirmedIssues.repro: SOURCE REPRO ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: compare energyUsedWh=null versus energyUsedWh=0 with the same positive distance/speed. num maps missing to 0 and both take the same neutral branch; page noEnergy says lacks energy in both. Alternatively use finite energyUsedWh=100, distanceM=5 and positive avgSpeedMps: energy is present but the same lacks-energy message appears. This finding does NOT request making an unsupported zero-energy simulation valid.
confirmedIssues.fix: Domain owner should expose accurate eligibility distinctions without fabricating model values, then an exact caller integration must retain unknown/recorded-zero/unsupported geometry states and localized recovery.
